shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; grep -n -i -C 4 'chartkit\|charts\|yagr\|timeseries\|time series' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,200p

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__ node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies dependencies --json 2>&1 | head -60

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json | node -e 'const a=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0));console.log(a.filter(v=>!v.includes("-")).slice(-15).join(" "))'); do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@$v peerDependencies --json | tr -d '\n ')"; done

npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@^8.12.0 2>&1 | tail -15 && node -e 'for (const p of ["chartkit","charts","yagr","uikit"]) console.log(p, require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/"+p+"/package.json").version)' && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh chartkit ChartKit settings GravityChartsPlugin YagrPlugin ChartKitRef 2>&1 | head -60

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0));console.log(JSON.stringify({deps:p.dependencies,peer:p.peerDependencies,exports:p.exports,main:p.main},null,1))'; find node_modules -path '*@gravity-ui/charts/package.json' -o -path '*@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json' | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit && ls -R build/docs | head -40; cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat index.d.ts types/index.d.ts; ls plugins/yagr plugins/yagr/types plugins/gravity-charts; cat plugins/yagr/index.d.ts plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts; cat plugins/yagr/types/index.d.ts plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat types/widget.d.ts plugins/yagr/types.d.ts; cat plugins/yagr/index.js plugins/gravity-charts/index.js; ls plugins/yagr/renderer

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && C=chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts; grep version $C/package.json yagr/package.json; ls $C/dist/docs 2>/dev/null $C/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; find $C/dist -name '*.d.ts' -path '*types/chart*' | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist && T=esm/core/types/chart; cat esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n -A30 'export interface ChartData' -r esm/core/types/*.d.ts | head -60; grep -n -B2 -A12 "type: 'datetime'\|AxisType\|title?:\|timestamp\|labels?:" $T/axis.d.ts | head -70

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types && sed -n 70,120p index.d.ts; grep -n -B1 -A6 'export interface ChartAxisTitle\b\|export interface ChartAxisTitle {' chart/axis.d.ts | head -20; grep -n 'export interface LineSeries\b\|export interface LineSeries<\|export interface LineSeriesData' -A25 chart/line.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -50; grep -n 'export interface ChartLegend' -A6 chart/legend.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep -n 'enabled?' -B3 chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/legend.d.ts | head -8; grep -n 'export interface ChartTitle' -A4 chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/title.d.ts; Y=yagr/dist; ls $Y; grep -rn 'export interface RawSerieData\|export type RawSerieData' -A30 $Y --include=*.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -40

T=yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; grep -n 'export interface ExtendedSeriesOptions' -A40 $T | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -45; grep -n 'export interface YagrConfig' -A40 $T | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -45; grep -n 'export interface YagrChartOptions\|export interface ChartOptions' -A30 $T | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -40; grep -n 'timeMultiplier\|ms\b' $T | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer && grep -n 'theme\|timeMultiplier\|timeZone\|locale\|legend' utils.js useWidgetData.js YagrWidget.js | head -40; grep -n 'type ChartType\|export interface LegendOptions' -A8 /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -24
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Card Loader Text Flex Label 2>&1 | head -40
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Card Loader Text Flex Label 2>&1 | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls SegmentedRadioGroup Card Loader; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; grep -n 'view\|type\|theme' Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -n 'size' Loader/Loader.d.ts; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|color" text/text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null| head; ls | grep -i -E 'text|alert|skeleton'

grep -n 'onUpdate\|value\|options\|name' types.d.ts | sed -n 1,30p; grep -n 'export interface AlertProps' -A25 Alert/types.d.ts | grep -E 'theme|title|message|view|actions|layout' ; grep -n 'LoaderSize =' Loader/Loader.d.ts; grep -rn "color?" Text/Text.d.ts text/colorText/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rn "TEXT_COLORS\|'secondary'" Text/colorText/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep -n sideEffects -A4 chartkit/package.json chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json yagr/package.json; grep -n "^import\|^export" chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.js chartkit/build/libs/settings/settings.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -n 'export type AlertTheme' -r uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/types.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat libs/settings/settings.d.ts | head -30; sed -n 1,40p components/ChartKit.js | sed -n 10,40p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && T=yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; grep -n 'export interface LegendOptions' -A14 $T | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*'; grep -n 'export interface LineSeriesOptions\|export interface CommonSeriesOptions' -A24 $T | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -40; grep -n 'label?\|size?' uikit/../yagr/node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; find . -path '*uplot/dist/uPlot.d.ts' | head -2; cat chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.d.ts

T=yagr/dist/YagrCore; grep -rn 'interface LegendOptions\|LegendOptions =' -A12 $T --include=*.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -16; grep -rln 'interface Axis\b' ../uplot/dist/ 2>/dev/null; grep -n 'label?:' ../../node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,80p Alert/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|/\*\*'; grep -n 'wrap\|justifyContent\|alignItems' layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/dist && cat index.html | grep -o '<script[^>]*>\|<link[^>]*>'; I=$(ls assets/index-*.js); grep -o 'import("[^"]*")' $I | sort -u | grep -v -E '/[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)?-' ; echo ---static; head -c 400 $I | grep -o 'from"[^"]*"' ; grep -c 'uPlot\|d3-' $I; grep -o 'import[^;]\{0,80\}isEmpty[^;]\{0,20\}' assets/*Widget*.js | head -3
